worldcombat.skill.leaftornado.summary: Raise a ring of sharp leaves at the aimed spot; every beat cuts the enemies inside and may fling leaf flecks into their eyes, cutting their accuracy.
worldcombat.skill.leaftornado.use.0: Turn a corridor or doorway into a lasting cutting area
worldcombat.skill.leaftornado.use.2: Keep rolling for accuracy drops with leaf flecks
worldcombat.skill.leaftornado.descriptio: Raise the vortex at the target; every beat deals about %1$s special damage to every enemy inside, with a %2$s chance to lower a target's accuracy by %3$s stage(s) (at most once per target per cast).
The vortex has a radius of %1$s blocks, lasts %2$s and cuts once every %3$s.
It can be raised at a chosen spot up to %1$s blocks away.
worldcombat.skill.leaftornado.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.leaftornado.preference: On: radius ×0.7, per-beat power ×1.35 and +15% blind chance, but +2 ticks wind-up and +4 ticks cooldown. Off: radius ×1.3 covers more ground, but per-beat power ×0.8 and the base blind chance.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Larger values raise the vortex from further away.
On: it prefers a target with other enemies nearby so the lasting cuts catch more. Off: it sorts like an ordinary ranged attack.
Aim this many ticks ahead of a moving target so the vortex lands across its path; 0 places it on the target's current spot, larger values intercept a charging foe.
On: it may leave a hold position to place the vortex. Off: it only casts when already in range.
worldcombat.skill.leaftornado.descriptio: The vortex stays where it landed, so an enemy that walks out escapes the later beats; the accuracy drop persists until combat ends.

With tight wrap on, the radius shrinks to about 0.7x, per-beat power rises to 1.35x and the blind chance gains 15%, at +2 ticks wind-up and +4 cooldown; with it off the radius grows to about 1.3x, per-beat power falls to 0.8x, and the blind chance stays at its base.
